meta: PoStory · Social media content studio for local shops

hero.eyebrow: Content made easy for local shops
hero.title:
Turn a phone photo
into a post-ready promo
hero.subtitle: {count} editable templates plus AI images. Drop in your shop name, offer and contact, and have Instagram, Facebook and Xiaohongshu posts ready in minutes, scheduled and waiting.
hero.note: Just an email. No card needed.

features.title: This week's posts, done in one place

templates.title: {count} templates, fully editable
templates.body: Restaurants, beauty, retail and holiday sales. Change any text, colour or photo, and fill in your shop details in one click.

ai.title: AI turns snapshots into promos
ai.body: Upload a phone photo of a dish or product, pick a scene and say what you want. Not quite right? Keep refining.

platforms.title: One design, every platform
platforms.body: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Xiaohongshu. Pick platforms and times, and see your whole posting plan at a glance.

bilingual.title: Works in Chinese and English
bilingual.body: The app and templates are bilingual, so you can write in Chinese and still make English posts for local customers.

compare.title: AI photo enhance
compare.subtitle: Drag the handle to compare
compare.note: Illustration only. Actual results depend on your photo.

steps.title: Three steps to a finished post

s1.title: Fill in your shop once
s1.body: Name, contact, address and slogan are added to every design automatically.

s2.title: Pick a template or use AI
s2.body: Start from the template library, or upload a photo and let AI handle the background and lighting.

s3.title: Export or schedule
s3.body: Download a high-res PNG, or pick platforms and a time to add it to your posting plan.

bottom.title: Try a few designs for free
bottom.body: Verify your email to get 10 template credits. Contact us for a membership when you're ready.
